[SWS_DM_00279] Cancellation of a Diagnostic Conversation before Response
Transmission
Upstream requirements:
RS_Diag_04167
⌈
On Cancellation of a
Diagnostic Conversation
in case a diagnostic request
is currently processed in context of this protocol and response transmission has not
yet been started, the
Diagnostic Server instance
shall abort all service pro-
cessing and skip sending any response, which implies
not
to call
apext::diag::
uds_transport::UdsTransportProtocolHandler::Transmit
of the respec-
tive UDS Transport Protocol Handler.
⌋
